description: List persons (contacts) from the tenant's connected Pipedrive account, or SEARCH them: pass `search` (name, e-mail or phone) to find a person — without it you only get one unsorted page. If the whole term finds nobody, each word is searched on its own (fuzzy: true in the result), so a misspelled surname still finds the person. `filters` common keys: org_id, first_char.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for paging)

search.description: Name, e-mail or phone, e.g. "Max Mustermann". At least 2 characters.

name: list_pipedrive_persons
